name: Focus Flow VR: Meditation & Mindfulness
summary:
Focus Flow VR: Meditation & Mindfulness

Focus Flow VR is a calm and immersive VR breathing experience designed to help you pause, slow down, and reconnect with your focus.

Enter a peaceful virtual environment with a glowing breathing ring, soft ambient music, gentle voice guidance, floating particles, and a lotus that blooms with your breath. Follow the inhale and exhale rhythm, watch the environment respond, and complete short calming sessions at your own pace.
